verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing describes automating recurring fixes, custom monitoring policies with remote script execution and alerts, automated detection and fixing of compliance drift, and an AI agent (Tia) that predicts, prevents, and fixes IT issues. Together these suggest a first-party capability for background automations. However, all of this is one-line pricing and homepage copy, with no documentation of how automations are configured, triggered, scheduled, or run unattended. missing for 10: documented setup of automation rules/triggers and scheduling, evidence of autonomous agent execution without a human in the loop, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
